title: Klarna AI assistant (vendor-authored account)
problem: Scale customer support across markets for a large payments platform.
depth: Vendor marketing; many controls not described
facts: Built on LangGraph with LangSmith tracing; described as multi-agent routing by the vendor.
Vendor-reported: 2.5 million conversations handled, 80% faster resolution, about 70% of repetitive tasks automated.
interpretations: Use as a critical-reading exercise: the source omits guardrails, data handling, fallback and escalation, which are the architect's real questions.
review_exercise: List the ten discovery questions you would ask Klarna before reusing this design, grouped by security, quality, escalation and cost.
lessons: Marketing case studies state outcomes, not architecture; do not copy numbers.
adaptation: Not adaptable without further primary evidence.
